newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT-Siderar initiated as market perform.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Siderar initiated as market perform.

text.p: -- Santander Investment started Argentine steelmaker Siderar as market perform.

-- "Capacity constraints should limit Siderar from taking full advantage of the expected seven to eight percent growth in domestic demand for steel products over the next two years," analyst Andres Biolcati wrote in a report.
-- "The company should increase its domestic sales volume by only five percent during this period."
-- Strong cash generation will allow the company to repay its debt and finance any planned investment.
-- "Our 12 to 18 month target price is $3.00 per share, leaving the stock with 7.1 percent upside potential based on our discounted cash flow model."
-- "Adding the expected 2.5 percent dividen yield, we arrive to a total expected return of 9.6 percent, which is in line with our expected return for the market."
